definitions.full: H5568. samar סָמַר verb bristle up (Lag BN 106 compare Arabic contract ; in that case ׳ס for ׳שׂ ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ס בְשָׂרִי מִמַּחְדְּךָ Psa 119:20 from fear of thee did my flesh bristle up , 'creep.' Pi`el Imperfect בְּשָׂרִי שַׂעֲרַת תְּסַמֵּר Job 4:15 .
